data.one_liner: Remote DevTools for Redux.dart to inspect state changes during runtime.
data.what_it_does: Connects a Dart Redux store to a Remote Devtools Server, enabling developers to inspect state changes and time-travel during runtime. It translates actions and states into JSON formats to communicate with the JavaScript Remote Devtools server.
use_when: You are using Redux for state management in Dart or Flutter and want to inspect state changes remotely.
You want to use time-travel debugging with Redux DevTools.
avoid_when: You are not using Redux as your state management solution.
Your actions and state are extremely difficult to serialize to JSON.
strengths: Enables powerful time-travel debugging for Redux.dart applications.
Supports custom action/state encoders and decoders.
weaknesses: Requires a running Node.js Remote Devtools server instance.
Actions and state must be JSON encodable for full functionality.
data.setup_notes: Requires running the remotedev-server via npm and configuring RemoteDevToolsMiddleware as the last middleware in your store.
